_comment: Berlin GLE profile - kept so switching BACK is one command. GLE 350 de: DIESEL plug-in hybrid, 33 kWh (petrus, Aug 14). SoC absent on standard PID 0x5B in the first read; EV data needs Mercedes-specific PIDs later.
